_comment: Taxa for anatomy ontologies that the OBO Foundry registry leaves blank (or that we judge too narrow). Each entry replaces the registry's taxon for that ontology. Candidates for upstream PRs to github.com/OBOFoundry/OBOFoundry.github.io/tree/master/ontology. NCBI IDs verified 2026-09-27.

aism.label: Insecta
aism.note: Registry has no taxon. AISM is the insect skeletomuscular umbrella ontology.

colao.label: Coleoptera
colao.note: Registry has no taxon. Built on AISM.

lepao.label: Lepidoptera
lepao.note: Registry has no taxon. Built on AISM.

oarcs.label: Arthropoda
oarcs.note: Registry has no taxon. Circulatory system only.

hao.label: Insecta
hao.note: JUDGMENT CALL: registry says Hymenoptera, but HAO matched 6/7 beetle terms. Delete this entry to go back to Hymenoptera only.
